title: Field Service Engineer. Ingenieur Service Client Ouest - Bordeaux (d/h/f)
desc: Êtes-vous prêt(e) à accélérer votre potentiel et à avoir un impact réel dans les sciences de la vie, le diagnostic et la biotechnologie ? Chez Beckman Coulter Diagnostics , l’une des plus de 15 sociétés opérationnelles de Danaher , notre travail sauve des vies — et nous sommes tous unis par un engagement commun à innover pour un impact concret. Vous vous épanouirez dans une culture d’appartenance où vous et votre point de vue unique comptez réellement. Et en tirant parti du système Danaher d’amélioration continue , vous contribuez à transformer les idées en impact — en innovant au rythme de la vie. En tant que leader mondial du diagnostic clinique, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics défie les conventions depuis plus de 90 ans afin de renforcer le rôle des laboratoires de diagnostic dans l’amélioration de la santé des patients. Nos solutions de diagnostic sont utilisées aussi bien pour des analyses cliniques courantes que complexes, dans les hôpitaux, les laboratoires de référence et de recherche, ainsi que dans les cabinets médicaux du monde entier. Chaque heure, plus d’un million de tests sont réalisés dans le monde sur les systèmes Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, impactant 1,2 milliard de patients et plus de trois millions de cliniciens chaque année. De la découverte de la prochaine avancée clinique à l’analyse rapide et fiable des échantillons, en passant par une prise de décision plus rigoureuse, nous permettons aux cliniciens d’offrir les meilleurs soins possibles à leurs patients grâce à une efficacité accrue, une confiance clinique renforcée, une collaboration adaptative et une intelligence accélérée. Découvrez le Danaher Business System , qui rend tout cela possible. L'ingénieur service clients chez Beckman Coulter Diagnostics est chargé de tout mettre en œuvre pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de l'équipement de production. Ce poste est rattaché au département Service et sera entièrement à distance. Chez Beckman Coulter, notre vision est de réimaginer sans relâche les soins de santé, un diagnostic à la fois. Basé(e) dans le secteur de Bordeaux, vous ferez partie de la région Ouest et serez rattaché(e) au Manager Régional responsable des activités techniques du Service Après-Vente. Si vous vous sentez à l'aise dans un rôle technique en contact avec le client et que vous souhaitez travailler à la mise en place d'une organisation de service de classe mondiale, lisez la suite. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'opportunité de : Planifier et exécuter les maintenances préventives de son parc alloué Prendre en charge les maintenances curatives Effectuer les installations des équipements et solutions Rendre compte de son activité dans l’outil de debrief des interventions techniques - Gérer son stock de pièces Les exigences essentielles du poste sont les suivantes : Connaissance de la biologie électronique et de l'informatique, de préférence 2 ou 3 ans d'expérience. Faire preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'un bon sens de l'organisation - Capacité d’adaptation - Bonne capacité de communication - Anglais professionnel requis Expérience dans le domaine du service sur le terrain dans le secteur médical ou des laboratoires Une expérience préalable dans les domaines suivants serait un plus : Expérience dans le domaine du diagnostic Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, société opérationnelle de Danaher , propose un large éventail de programmes d’avantages sociaux complets et compétitifs qui apportent une réelle valeur ajoutée à notre quotidien. Qu’il s’agisse de couverture santé ou de congés payés, nos programmes contribuent à l’équilibre de vie au-delà du travail. Découvrez nos avantages sur Danaher Benefits Info . Chez Beckman, nous croyons en la définition d’une organisation du travail meilleure et plus durable. Nous reconnaissons les avantages du mode de travail flexible pour les postes qui le permettent et nous nous engageons à offrir des carrières enrichissantes, peu importe les modalités de travail. Ce poste est admissible à un mode de travail en distanciel dans le cadre duquel vous pouvez travailler pleinement à distance à partir de votre domicile. Cela vous sera expliqué lors du process de recrutement. Explorez la flexibilité et les défis que peut offrir le fait de travailler pour nous. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit . title: Product UX/UI Expert
desc: Our Product Department is looking for a Talented UX/UI Expert to join our quest for outstanding User Experience! Main responsibility will be turning our powerful web application software into easy-to-use products for our clients and create both functional and appealing features that address our clients’ needs and help us grow our customer base. This will include planning & designing all UX aspects of new product development: Gather and evaluate User Requirements in collaboration with Product Managers and Developers Plan & illustrate UX & design using wireframes Offer engaging designs for all new product developments. Produce complete & documented product definition for the R&D team Work closely with R&D on the implementation Identify and troubleshoot UX problems (e.g., responsiveness) Stay up-to-date with modern enterprise style standards - Good eye for modern web and mobile design! Proven work experience as a UX/UI Designer in enterprise B2B product – at least 5 years · Experience in Figma Very high level of logical capabilities – to understand a complex enterprise product Knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Wireframe.cc and InVision) - Needs to be able to produce understandable wireframes and explain decisions Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Photoshop/Sketch at a high level · Portfolio of design projects HTML/CSS + Slicing best practices (turn a design into the HTML/CSS) Understanding of modern responsive design and how it affects layout and usability Experience in complicated WEB products/system Team spirit: strong communication skills to collaborate with various stakeholders (Product manager, R&D and more) Bonus points for: Proven experience in (inbound) product management – detailed product definitions and in-depth work with R&D during the implementation Qmarkets , a leading Innovation & Idea Management Software Company serving the Global Enterprise Market Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Linux-Systemadministrator (Junior) – 2nd-Level-Support im Hosting (m/w/d)
desc: deine aufgaben Worum es geht Der 1st Level nimmt die Tickets an und sortiert vor. Ab da bist du dran. Webstack-Fehler eingrenzen, Mailprobleme debuggen, Konfigurationen auf Systemebene korrigieren. Wenn ein Thema dreimal vorkommt, schreibst du ein Runbook. Was du bei uns machst L2-Tickets bearbeiten: Webstack-Fehler eingrenzen, Mail-Zustellbarkeit debuggen, Konfigurationsprobleme in Hosting-Umgebungen lösen, Backup-/Restore-Fälle auf Systemebene durchführen Fehler analysieren und beheben: Ursachen eingrenzen, kontrolliert lösen, so dokumentieren, dass Kollegen den Fall jederzeit übernehmen könnten Standard-Changes durchführen: Wiederherstellungen, Konfigurationsanpassungen, Monitoring-Follow-ups im Managed-Betrieb Eskalationen vorbereiten: Komplexere Fälle mit Logs, Tests und klarer Abgrenzung an Spezialisten übergeben Support weiterentwickeln: Wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder in Runbooks und Checklisten überführen dein profil Was du mitbringen solltest Linux-Systembetrieb: Shell-sicher, Dienste und Logs verstehen, Konfigurationen kontrolliert ändern Web- und Mail-Stack: Erfahrung mit Webservern (z. B. NGINX, Apache), PHP-Runtimes (z. B. PHP-FPM), Datenbanken (z. B. MySQL, MariaDB) und gängigen Mailserver-Setups Hosting-Grundlagen: DNS, SSL/TLS, Domainverwaltung, typische Zugriffs- und Recovery-Wege (Rescue, Konsole, IPMI) sowie ein Verständnis für die Unterschiede zwischen Shared Hosting, VPS und Dedicated Strukturierte Fehleranalyse: Du gehst Probleme systematisch an und dokumentierst, was du getan hast Kommunikation: Gutes Deutsch, technisches Englisch. Klar und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden und im Team. Wer etwas nicht weiß, fragt nach. Plus, wenn du es hast: Hosting-Panels (z. B. Plesk) · Virtualisierung (z. B. KVM, Proxmox) · Monitoring (z. B. checkmk, Grafana) · Ansible/Shell-Skripting · Windows/AD-Basics warum wir? Was du dafür bekommst 100 % remote , freie Hardware-Wahl. Linux-Setups ausdrücklich willkommen Home-Office-Zuschuss 30 Urlaubstage Fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Ob Richtung Systemadministration, Netzwerk oder Entwicklung. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich in die Richtung zu bewegen, die zu dir passt. Ein kleines Team, in dem man sich kennt und nicht hinter Ticketnummern verschwindet So läuft die Bewerbung Bewerbung unter Beantwortung einiger Fragen → Videocall zum Kennenlernen (ca. 30 Minuten) → Videocall mit Interview und Work Samples (ca. 90 Minuten) → Entscheidung. title: Preparador/a de oposiciones de Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos (Auxiliar, Ayudant
desc: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy ¿Trabajas en una biblioteca, archivo o museo público, o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza. 📚 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en Bibliotecas, Archivos y Museos , en el que cada profesional aporte su experiencia en su ámbito y en su nivel. No necesitas dominar todas las categorías. Puedes especializarte en Bibliotecas, Archivos o Museos , y en uno o varios niveles : Auxiliar, Ayudante o Facultativo/Conservador. 🗂️ Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores ⭐ Auxiliares (C1 / C2) Auxiliar de Bibliotecas Auxiliar de Archivos Auxiliar de Museos Se convocan sobre todo en comunidades autónomas, ayuntamientos, diputaciones y universidades, con denominaciones y grupo que varían según la administración. ⭐ Ayudantes (A2) Ayudantes de Bibliotecas Ayudantes de Archivos Ayudantes de Museos En el Estado, Cuerpo de Ayudantes de Archivos, Bibliotecas y Museos. En otras administraciones, escalas equivalentes con su propia denominación. Facultativos y Conservadores (A1) Facultativos de Bibliotecas Facultativos de Archivos Conservadores de Museos En el Estado, Cuerpo Facultativo de Archiveros, Bibliotecarios y Arqueólogos y Cuerpo Facultativo de Conservadores de Museos. En otras administraciones, escalas superiores equivalentes. 🏛️ Una misma profesión, muchas convocatorias Estas oposiciones las convocan administraciones muy distintas, y cada una tiene su denominación, su temario y su forma de examinar. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan procesos selectivos de: Administración General del Estado / Ministerio de Cultura Comunidades Autónomas Ayuntamientos y otras entidades locales Diputaciones Universidades públicas Otros organismos públicos En las convocatorias autonómicas, locales y universitarias, la normativa y los sistemas de cada territorio o institución marcan la diferencia. Por eso queremos contar con preparadores de todas las comunidades autónomas . 🌟 Quiénes somos En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros . Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento . Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia . La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento. 🔎 A quién buscamos Profesionales con plaza (funcionarios/as o personal laboral fijo, en activo o en excedencia) en bibliotecas, archivos o museos públicos. Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones. Personas capaces de trabajar las dos caras de la oposición : el contenido técnico de la profesión (biblioteconomía, archivística, museología, gestión de colecciones, normalización…), y la legislación y el contenido específico de la administración que convoca, incluida la normativa autonómica cuando corresponda. Quienes dominen las pruebas prácticas : catalogación y clasificación, descripción archivística, documentación de fondos museográficos… Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar : explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación. Soltura con herramientas digitales . Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor. 🎯 En qué podrás colaborar Según tu ámbito, tu nivel y tu disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos: Clases online del temario técnico y del temario específico de cada administración. Supuestos prácticos: diseñarlos, resolverlos y corregir los de los alumnos. Legislación de patrimonio, bibliotecas, archivos y museos , estatal y autonómica. Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real. Preparación de pruebas orales o de desarrollo , en los niveles superiores. Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar. Temarios, esquemas, resúmenes y vídeos cortos. 🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos , compatible con tu actividad profesional. Si tienes plaza, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto . Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible. 🌍 100 % remoto 🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir 📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio 💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables 🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección Queremos conocerte enseñando , no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos: 1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto . Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu ámbito (bibliotecas, archivos o museos), tu nivel, en qué comunidad autónoma trabajas y qué administraciones conoces. 2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos. 3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos : la explicación de un contenido del temario o la resolución de un supuesto práctico (por ejemplo, un ejercicio de catalogación o de descripción archivística), con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil. Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza en bibliotecas, archivos o museos y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte. 👉 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy . Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Digital Designer
desc: Lagos, Nigeria | Full time | Remote Summary: We are looking to add a talented digital designer to our team! We will task the designer with creating interactive online content and maintaining a smooth user interface for our new digital magazine. You'll be responsible for the translations of content across various digital platforms, producing content that matches the company's brand, aesthetic, and marketing strategy, including social media graphics, website banners, and promotional artwork. The ideal candidate should be able to combine creativity, functionality, and technology to produce eye-catching and informative content. In this role, organizational and technical skills are key, and all candidates must possess in-depth knowledge of design software programs. Responsibilities: Design, produce, and manage all our interactive online content, including email templates, social media, and promotional artwork. Prepare briefs for each project and presenting design ideas to all the relevant stakeholders. Collaborate with the different departments within the publication to ensure that all designs align with the brand image, while meeting usability and website standards. Ensure consistency in designs and content across all company platforms. Transform wireframes into intuitive user interfaces. Review product positioning and online content to identify room for improvement. Work with the IT department to oversee the smooth implementation of new content. Provide advice and guidance on the aesthetic for campaigns, projects, and promotional events. ABOUT MARIE CLAIRE NIGERIA Marie Claire International is entering Africa, with Nigeria being the flagship market. We have designed Marie Claire Nigeria to amplify the captivating voice of contemporary women through various touch points. From trend-setting fashion to outstanding features, Marie Claire Nigeria is set to impact women across the continent and beyond. Requirements Requirements Bachelor's degree in digital design, graphic design, or a related field. Proven experience in a professional digital design role. A portfolio of previous digital design work to showcase experience and creativity. Proficiency with required desktop publishing tools, including Photoshop, InDesign Quark, and Illustrator. Understanding of marketing, production, website design, corporate identity, product packaging, advertisements, and multimedia design. Ability to present design ideas and concepts for campaigns and projects. A team player with exceptional organizational and technical skills Originally posted on Himalayas

title: UI/UX Designer
desc: About Us: At edclub , we are committed to revolutionizing the way K-12 students learn through engaging and interactive educational content. We create comprehensive, high-quality courses that inspire curiosity and facilitate deep learning. We're seeking a talented Designer to join our dynamic team to help bring educational content to life with creativity and purpose. Job Description: We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our team. In this role, you will design educational materials that enhance learning experiences for students. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of user experience principles and a passion for creating intuitive, visually appealing digital products. You will collaborate with project managers, developers, and content creators to produce visually engaging and interactive educational tools This role will be fully remote, as our headquarters are located in Rockville, Maryland, USA. Key Responsibilities: Create graphics, illustrations, and visual elements for experiences that align with educational objectives. Work closely with curriculum and content teams to ensure design elements support educational goals. Ensure a consistent visual style that is age-appropriate and accessible to diverse audiences. Collaborate with the team to brainstorm creative ideas and solutions for presenting content in innovative ways. Create engaging animations and motion graphics to enhance student learning and understanding. Stay up-to-date with design trends, animation techniques, and educational tools to continuously improve content quality. Qualifications: 3-5 years of proven experience in graphic and UI/UX design. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Illustrator; experience with animation tools like After Effects, Blender, or similar. Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design and animation work. Understanding of visual storytelling, typography, and layout principles. Knowledge of user-centered design principles and how students of different age groups engage with content. Communicate effectively in English with team members. Collaborative attitude with a willingness to accept feedback and adapt designs accordingly. Ability to think creatively and bring innovative ideas to enhance student engagement. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Become a Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator - Parndorf
desc: Join the global community that enhances and elevates the experience of the most prestigious luxury brands in the world! CXG , a leading customer experience agency servicing premium and luxury brands, is looking for mission-based Customer Experience Evaluators who are existing luxury brand customers. As a Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator, you can perform several evaluations per month and provide your valuable feedback via a questionnaire. Your assignments will be as diverse as our luxury clients and industries, ranging from fashion and high-end jewelry to cosmetics, luxury watches, automotives, and more. Your evaluations may involve visiting a store, returning a purchase, buying a product online, or making an appointment with a store. Please note: Applicants should not have worked for luxury retail brands to ensure the integrity and objectivity of the evaluations. Your feedback can influence brand strategies and help shape a brand's strategy, making this an opportunity for you to have a meaningful impact on the luxury market. Responsibilities: Conduct discreet evaluations of your favorite luxury brands in-store, online, or sometimes both. Provide objective feedback about your experiences. Choose assignments that align with your profile and interests. Complete questionnaires after each evaluation. Comply with all given project objectives and special requirements from the luxury brand we represent How to Apply: To become an evaluator with us, follow these simple steps: Register on live.cxg.com and receive an email with your credentials. Log into our platform and tell us more about yourself. Once this is done, our team will verify your profile and contact you. Check the ‘welcome package’ and pass the general certification. You’re now ready! You are now available for assignments and can browse and apply for any opportunities that interest you. About CXG : CXG is a global customer experience agency servicing premium and luxury brands. Our 12 offices around the world are able to service 70 countries. We are a team of 220+ customer experience experts and a network of over 80,000 evaluators worldwide. Learn more about what we do at . Enjoy the flexibility of working from our mobile application where you can search and apply for missions, take certifications, submit surveys, and much more, all on the go. Contact us for more information! Requirements Must be 18 years or older. Existing client of premium and luxury brands. Not contractually engaged with any retail brands, to maintain integrity. Punctual, organized, detail-oriented, reliable. Observant, passionate about customer experience. No prior experience needed, we look for honest feedback from real customers. Originally posted on Himalayas

desc: As a Graphic Design Intern, you will design high-quality visual assets for our online health programs and social channels. Portfolio of past work: sample posts, reels, short videos, or written articles demonstrating strong storytelling, visual sense, and engagement. Hands-On Content Skills Proficiency in graphic and video editing software (e.g., Figma, Photoshop). Bonus: Familiarity with video editing. Not Your Typical Workplace… Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with. At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it. An Amsterdam scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. An Antwerp founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter. This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence. You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you. Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out. Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong. Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price. Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving. Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory. What It Takes to Make an Impact Here: Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another target-driven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers. Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal. Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to. AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date. Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day. Dutch Native: Native-level Dutch and business-fluent English. Bonus Points If You Bring Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions. First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals. Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role. Not Your Typical Team: We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together. We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home. The Perks of Being Here… Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours. Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax. Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships. Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups! Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.
